waypoints.name: Albula Pass

sections.advice: Thusis → Bergun is 31 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Bergun → Albula Pass climbs about 2312 m in 12 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Albula Pass → La Punt Chamues-ch drops about 2312 m over 7 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

scenicChapters.title: Albula Pass Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 57 km this is Albula Pass Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2312 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

albula-pass-road.story: 90 km one way from Thusis - plan on about 1 h 33 of riding. On the way it passes Bergun and Albula Pass. The highest point is about 2,450 m. Albula Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

places-temples-in-the-town-of-cuencame-a.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-temples-in-the-town-of-cuencame-a.story: A 284 km round trip from Cuencamé de Ceniceros - roughly 4 h 54 in the saddle. It goes by way of Chapel of the Refugio of the former hacien, Architectonic ensemble of the Town of Naza, Town of San Pedro del Gallo and back through Architectonic ensemble of the Town of Naza. The highest point is about 1,850 m. The line favours views over speed.

legend-golden-circle.slogan: Golden Circle – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-golden-circle.story: curated scenic road. geysers, waterfalls, rift valley. From Reykjavík it runs 192 km to Reykjavík; allow about 3 h 29 of riding. On the way it passes Golden Circle and Selfoss. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Golden Circle
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 9 km this is Golden Circle, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
